TestTurtleEval.how: every evaluation test of the W3C Turtle test suite, its files byte for byte as W3C serves them (app/specs/turtle/spec.json), is in an acceptance vector of the turtle guests, which answer pass only when the reader's verdict on each is the suite's; prismpm build runs them and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors
